episodes.title: The Birds Don't Sing, They Screech in Pain
episodes.summary: A run-in with a hostile motorist sends Danny into a rage — and a tense chase across town. Amy's unexpected guest leaves a lasting impression.

episodes.title: The Rapture of Being Alive
episodes.summary: An enraged Amy finds new purpose as cracks in her seemingly perfect marriage begin to show. Danny seeks a fresh start for his failing family business.

episodes.title: I Am Inhabited by a Cry
episodes.summary: Danny experiences a catharsis in the presence of an old flame. Amy's relationship with George suffers another setback. A catfishing scheme goes too far.

episodes.title: Just Not All at the Same Time
episodes.summary: With her future hanging in a balance, Amy heads to Las Vegas for work while a smitten Paul and an exasperated Danny follow wild pursuits of their own.

episodes.title: Such Inward Secret Creatures
episodes.summary: As George makes a new friend, Danny proposes a dangerous plan, Amy agrees to a rendezvous, and Naomi acts on a hunch.

episodes.title: We Draw a Magic Circle
episodes.summary: Fumi's pointed comments and Naomi's meddling put Amy and George on edge. As Isaac hustles to get out of trouble, Danny receives an unexpected offer.

episodes.title: I Am a Cage
episodes.summary: Amy and Danny both experience positive changes in their lives, but lingering secrets and emotional challenges force them to confront hard truths.

episodes.title: The Drama of Original Choice
episodes.summary: Painful memories of her youth push Amy to confront her family issues and marital woes. Danny spins an elaborate lie that leads him down a dangerous path.

episodes.title: The Great Fabricator
episodes.summary: Danny moves from fear into panic as new crises arise. Willing to do whatever it takes to keep June safe, Amy devises a perilous scheme.

episodes.title: Figures of Light
episodes.summary: The consequences of their actions leave Danny and Amy in a surreal situation that tests their grasp on reality.

episodes.title: All the Things We're Never Going to Have
episodes.summary: Country-club employees Ashley and Austin witness a vicious fight between their boss and his wife — and decide to leverage it to get ahead.

episodes.title: A New Starting Point for Further Desires
episodes.summary: While Josh tries to play off Ashley's ascendance at the club, Lindsay seeks petty revenge. The Chairwoman proposes changes at the gym.

episodes.title: The Increasing Flimsiness of Any Certainties About the Future
episodes.summary: Josh and Lindsay consider a new chapter for their lives. Ashley encourages Austin to get closer to Eunice.

episodes.title: Oh, the Comfort, the Inexpressible Comfort
episodes.summary: When Austin and Ashley are trapped for hours in an ER waiting room, Josh sees an opportunity to turn the tables.

episodes.title: I Am Killing My Flesh without It
episodes.summary: Lindsay and Josh's marital strife comes to a head when an unexpected crisis hits home.

episodes.title: Those Blue Remembered Hills
episodes.summary: Josh and Austin try to mend fences with a training session. Lindsay tutors Ashley in the delicate art of winning over the club's wives.

episodes.title: The Hour of Separation
episodes.summary: Ashley, Lindsay and Ava's girls' getaway to Seoul is upended by old tensions, new revelations and shocking confessions at 30,000 feet.

episodes.title: It Will Stay This Way and You Will Obey
episodes.summary: Fighting for survival on the Chairwoman's home turf, both couples must decide what — and for whom — they're willing to sacrifice.
